[]>iri: Ah, <ap>there it is. <advance><lc>There you are,<ap> Æther.
[]>iri: How nice it is to look at you.<ap>
I can only imagine how nice it must be, to be you. <ap>Accomplished, <ap> tolerated, <ap> beloved.
[]>iri: Every day you go to work. Make money.<ap> Socialize with your coworkers. 
[]>iri: You feel good.
[]>iri: And every night you spend with your friends. These people love you <ap>and you love them.<ap> [b]Unconditionally.[/b]
[]>iri: And in between you even find the time to keep your room in shape! <ap>💖
[]>iri: You got everything you ever needed. <ap>You're save. <ap>You're settled.
[]>iri: The way you fit in,<ap> it makes me happy to witness.<ap> Everything has been leading up to this.<ap> To you, here. <ap> [i]Gods[/i] have been killed because there has been more faith in [b][i]you.[/i][/b]
[]>iri: Aren't you glad to be in this role? To be revered?

choices.choice_text.disabled: You dont get a say in this.

content.content:
[]>iri: Of course you are. This stasis you've been granted <ap>many would give much more than you to get here.
[]>iri: But you deserve it <ap>💗
[]>iri: And so, dutifully, you continue. 
[]>iri: Day in. <mp>Day out. <mp>Day in. <mp>Day out. <mp>Day in-

[]>iri: What was that?
[]>aether: ...
[]>iri: [i]...[/i]
[]>iri: [b]Day.<ap> [i]out[/i][/b].
[]>iri: Day in and out,<ap> you spend in this lustrous maze of mirrors. Surrounded by beauty.
[]>iri: Say,<ap> you glamorous thing,<ap> don't you recognize your splendor?

choices.choice_text.disabled: You've never known what you look like

choices.choice_text.enabled: There are no mirrors in this maze

[]>iri:This template also comes with CG support. <lc>I will use this to tell you about where I got the music for this demo.

[]>iri:Loyalty Freak Music is anticapitalist and antifascist. <ap>[b]Those are good things.[/b]
<mp>And the music rocks too. (As you can see in the script, newline characters don't need to be escaped in any capacity.)
[]>iri:CGs are fullscreen illustrations that you use to highlight cool scenes in your visual novel. <mp>They are absolutely not [i]necessary[/i] - but can add some nice polish.
[]>iri:When this line ends with the next click, the CG will disappear again. <mp>Tada! <call:hide_cg>

[]>iri:With that, we can start to wrap up.
[]>amber:Change of scenery please!

[]>iri:There you go <3
[]>iri:Dear reader; This template comes with all the simple things you need to make your own visual novel. There's a guide for the setup [url=https://github.com/SnekOfSpice/dialog-editor/wiki/Using-the-visual-novel-template]here[/url]. I would recommend you still know the very basics of Godot, maybe look into how to use themes.

[]>iri:How can you leave this place again? Well you can just terminate the page by not having it point to a page again. <mp>[rainbow freq=1.0 sat=0.8 val=0.8]Go out there and create![/rainbow]
